correctness.rationale: A smooth degree-four del Pezzo has exactly sixteen (-1)-curves, and negative-definite chamber supports are exactly independent subsets of their intersection graph. The explicit blow-up divisor pairing is checked against an independent even-subset graph. The 393 supports are exhaustive. The full W(D5) is all 1920 even-translation signed permutations; conjugation enumerates exactly 18 classes. Direct 393-permutation cycles for every group element and independent union-of-line-orbits fixed-subset counts agree, yielding 18 distinct full spectra. Trepalin proves q>=4 existence. All assumptions and limits are stated.

value.rationale: The arithmetic splitting of Zariski chambers is motivated by stable-base-locus and cohomology chamber geometry. The classification recovers an entire Frobenius Weyl conjugacy class from a natural 393-point scheme, and proves that ordinary exceptional-line zeta data cannot recover it, with actual q>=4 realizable examples. This is not a textbook deduction from the known 393 geometric total.
